mapper.update: update notification set is_read = 1 where notification_id = #{notificationId}
mapper.select: select n.*,u.user_name as sender_name from notification n left join user u on n.sender_id = u.user_id where n.user_id = #{user_id} order by n.create_time desc
select count(*) from notification where user_id = #{userId} and type = 1 and is_read = 0
select count(*) from notification where super_notification_id = #{superNotificationId} and user_id = #{userId}
